name: Quang Ninh Museum
kicker: The coal-block building on Cua Luc
summary: Coal-block museum on Cửa Lục: see more than 30,000 objects between 8:00 and 17:00, with a break at noon. Salvador Pérez Arroyo designed the glass block on Trần Quốc Nghiễn. Adult entry is 40,000 đồng. Use it on a morning when the boat is another day.
getThere: Đường Trần Quốc Nghiễn, across Bai Chay Bridge from Bai Chay
heroCaption: The facade, with the words Bảo tàng Quảng Ninh

notice.title: Two ward lines
notice.body: The museum’s own address line is phường Hạ Long, Thành phố Quảng Ninh. The map node sits in phường Hồng Gai. The homepage carries the label “2013 năm thành lập”.

body: The building sits on Đường Trần Quốc Nghiễn, a glass block compared to coal, facing Vịnh Cửa Lục. Salvador Pérez Arroyo is the architect. The collection is more than 30,000 objects.
Hours are 8:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00. The library line “7 ngày/tuần” belongs to the library in the same building.

figures.caption: The facade from the side, with the coal lump and the lettering
figures.alt: Quang Ninh Museum from an angle, with the coal form and the sign

gettingThere: Đường Trần Quốc Nghiễn. Walk if you are already on the Hồng Gai shore. From Bãi Cháy you cross Cầu Bãi Cháy.

legs.heading: From the Hong Gai shore
legs.body: On Trần Quốc Nghiễn. The museum’s own page says phường Hạ Long. The map node says phường Hồng Gai.

legs.heading: From Bai Chay
legs.body: Across Cầu Bãi Cháy to Trần Quốc Nghiễn.

closed: The library line “7 ngày/tuần” belongs to the library. The museum hours above are the ones to use.
admissionNote: The operator cites Nghị quyết 131/2018/NQ-HĐND. Adult 40,000 đồng. University, college, and vocational students 20,000 đồng. Children 7–16 and school pupils 10,000 đồng.
